how_run: npm ci in /home/user/application-tracker (postinstall runs tsc -b && vite build), then `npx vite preview --port 4391 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1` serving dist/. The Express/MariaDB server was not started. Capture script: /home/user/shots-work/tracker/capture.mjs (mock data in mockdata.mjs). Playwright context uses locale id-ID and timezone Asia/Jakarta.
mock_summary: All /api calls fulfilled via page.route following server/routes + shared/types.ts: GET /api/auth/me returns user Dimas Arya Nugroho (fictional), GET /api/state returns a full DB object, GET /api/health returns ok. Seed: 15 applications across all 11 real stages (wishlist, applied, screening, hr_interview, user_interview, technical_test, offer, rejected, ghosted, withdrawn; none accepted) at fictional companies (Kanvas Labs, Paylane, Jelajah, Bank Sinar and others). Each has full status history, IDR salary ranges (Rp 18-60 jt), sources, tags and documents. Also 34 activities, 13 reminders (interviews, take-home, follow-ups, server-style 'Besok: Deadline X' items), 5 documents, 2 interview notes, 3 bookmarks, 3 company wishes, and the default tags. Landing capture uses /api/auth/me -> {user:null}. Plus Jakarta Sans (inline @font-face pointing at fonts.gstatic.com) is served from @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans with each subset file mapped to its matching file. Flaticon UIcons CDN CSS and fonts are served from @flaticon/flaticon-uicons; all 68 icon classes used in src/ exist in that package. accounts.google.com/gsi/client is replaced with a no-op stub so the sign-in page does not show the 'Gagal masuk' toast. The real Google button is invisible anyway.
issues: Google Identity Services is stubbed. The landing page looks the same as production because the GSI button is rendered with opacity 0 under the app's own button, but sign-in cannot be clicked through.
desktop-full.png and statistics-full.png were taken by growing the viewport to the page height (1362 and 1205 px), not with fullPage. With fullPage, the fixed sidebar ends at 900 px.
mobile.png is cropped at a clean section edge (2209 CSS px = 4418 device px), so the last dashboard section ('Lamaran' recent list) is left out.
All company names in the mock job search are fictional, so the screenshot does not suggest real applications.
